chunks: Suleiman ibn Ahmad ibn Ayoob al-Lakhmy narrated that Abdul Vahhab ibn Kharajih said: Abu Kurib narrated that Ali ibn Hafs al-Abasi said: Al-Hasan ibn al-Hussein al-Alavi narrated from his father Al-Hussein ibn Zayd, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn al-Hussein, from Al-Hussein ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them) that the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The head of intellect, after faith in God, the Mighty and Exalted, is endearing oneself to the people.

key_terms.رَأْسُ الْعَقْلِ: The head or pinnacle of intellect

ai.seo_question: What is considered the highest form of intellect after faith in God according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq places this hadith within the chapter on intellectual virtues, framing 'al-tahabbub' (cultivating affection) not merely as social etiquette but as a practical manifestation of true *aql* (intellect) that bridges the gap between divine belief and human interaction. This concept is central to Shia ethical theology, where social harmony is viewed as a prerequisite for spiritual perfection and a reflection of the Prophet’s own character. By prioritizing affection, the tradition highlights that rationality in Islam is inherently relational, requiring the active maintenance of bonds to sustain communal cohesion.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 1-55 Suleiman ibn Ahmad ibn Ayoob al-Lakhmy narrated that Abdul Vah’hab ibn Kharajih quoted on the authority of Abu Kurayb, on the authority of Ali ibn Hafs al-Abasi, on the authority of Al-Hassan ibn al-Hussein al-Alavi, on the authority of his father Al-Hussein ibn Zayd, on the authority of Ja’far ibn Muhammad as-Sadiq (MGB), on the authority of his father Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (MGB), on the authority of Ali ibn al-Hussein as-Sajjad (MGB), on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Ali , on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “
The most intelligent characteristic after having faith in God the Honorable the Exalted is expressing love for the people.”
